name: Future Network Weimar Triangle: Science for Europe - Doctoral candidates (to Germany)
summary: The programme “Future Network Weimar Triangle: Science for Europe” aims to expand the political initiative “Weimar Triangle”, launched in 1991 by the foreign ministers of Germany, France, and Poland, to include a sustainable science
